javascript: Optional, for ggds-table--stack: @ggds/js names each cell after its column and keeps the table roles for screen readers. Without it, the table stays a table that scrolls sideways.
classes: A box that scrolls a wide table sideways. Give it role="region", tabindex="0" and aria-labelledby.
The caption: what the table shows.
On a narrow screen, each row becomes a card with every cell under its column's name, so people read down instead of sideways. Needs @ggds/js.
